_note: CGWB National Hydrograph Network wells in Mumbai City + Mumbai Suburban, transcribed from the CGWB Ground Water Year Book of Maharashtra (2024-25 canonical, 2022-23 stitched for multi-year depth). Mumbai is EXCLUDED from the CGWB Dynamic Ground Water Resources Assessment (no block safe/critical/over-exploited class), so these wells - not a block choropleth - are the authoritative groundwater rendering. Levels run May/Aug/Nov + Jan, four seasons per Year Book, current to Jan 2025. The `quality` block (where present) is the major-ion panel from the CGWB Maharashtra groundwater-quality report (Annexure IX, pre-monsoon May 2022); trace Fe/As/U from Annexure VIII (NHS 2019-20). All monitored wells are shallow phreatic dug wells; no DWLR/telemetric stations exist for Mumbai. REGIONAL (MMR): extended beyond the BMC districts with Year Book 2024-25 wells across Thane, Palghar (Vasai) and Raigad (Panvel/Uran), coordinate-filtered to the urban metro, so every non-BMC corporation has nearby groundwater monitoring (levels only for the added districts - chemistry not yet extracted there).
district: Mumbai City + Suburban + Thane + Palghar + Raigad (MMR)
source_label: CGWB Ground Water Year Book of Maharashtra + GW Quality report
quality_note: Pre-monsoon (May 2022) major-ion chemistry. EC in uS/cm; ions in mg/l; As and U in ug/l. BIS 10500 acceptable limits: chloride 250, nitrate 45, fluoride 1.0, TDS 500. Salinity (EC > 3000 uS/cm) threshold: no Mumbai well exceeds it.

_citation_trace_2026_07_26: The MH 2024-25 edition (publication id 2016, posted 23 Mar 2026) is therefore unretrievable today; these 53 wells stay on the VERIFIED 2022-23 edition, whose direct pdf url does resolve. RETRIEVAL IS BROKEN AT CGWB'S END - established 2026-07-26, do not repeat this. The publications warehouse at cgwb.gov.in/cgwbpnm/ LISTS both 2024-25 Year Books with titles, posting dates and publication ids, but there is no working public route to the PDFs. Eight automated routes were tried and all return the same 33 KB Drupal 404 ('paged nahin mila', plain openresty HTTP/2 404 - no WAF, no captcha, no challenge): download/<id>; publication-detail/<id>; the CSRF POST to publication/<id> followed by the download, replicating the site's own downloadPdf() JS; a cookie-jar session; deriving the path from the thumbnail id; a directory listing on uploads/documents/; search engines (not indexed); and the retired /Regions/<REGION>/Reports/ path. CONFIRMED IN A REAL BROWSER by the maintainer the same day: the page renders and the publications are visible, but the download does not work there either. So this is NOT a bot block, NOT a session problem and NOT something a browser fetch solves - an earlier version of this note said 'fetch it from a browser session', which was wrong. Only /cgwbpnm/ itself and /cgwbpnm/public/* static assets serve; every other route under /cgwbpnm/ 404s, which looks like a reverse-proxy misconfiguration on their side. The id scheme is <unix-seconds><random>, verified three ways (1688105823 = 30 Jun 2023 matches the 2017-18 PDF's own creation timestamp; 1774431953 and 1774326882 match the two 2026 posting dates), but the thumbnail and the PDF get DIFFERENT random suffixes, so the path cannot be derived from anything the listing exposes. NEXT STEPS, in order: (1) the cgwb-yearbook-* registry entries watch the download/<id> link set, so a re-upload or a route fix changes the set and we get told; (2) failing that, email CGWB SECR Chennai / CR Nagpur, or RTI. Not an engineering problem.
